evidence: task.toml [environment] (lines 20-24): build_timeout_sec=600.0, network_mode="public", cpus=2, memory_mb=4096 - byte-identical to the frozen template task.toml lines 20-24 and to staged-task-contract.md lines 56-60; `diff` of task.toml vs template differs only in [task] name/description/keywords and [metadata] (lines 5-15). No docker_image and no allow_internet anywhere in task.toml (grep returned none), satisfying quality-checks.md #9 and staged-task-contract.md line 78. No secret literal under [environment]; the only credential-shaped values are in [verifier.env] (line 34 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" interpolation, line 35 empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) which is the frozen template block, not the agent environment. environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...) is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (diff empty): node:22-bookworm-slim, NODE_PATH, apt ca-certificates/git/procps/sqlite3, npm -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1, COPY instructions/assets, /app git init; no ENV/ARG secret. grep for key/secret/token/password across environment/ found only walls-and-retention.md line 3 'Everyone signs in with `password123`' - a public seed demo login the brief intends the agent to use, not a credential. Nothing secretly needs an install (internal-sheet annotation): integration.md line 3 publicly states Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 preinstalled globally via NODE_PATH; golden requires only express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins (crypto, fs, path); solve.sh only copies files. 2 CPU / 4 GB is ample for a Node+SQLite server and agent tooling. Runtime: raw-evidence-index hashes for run_golden.sh (b61aa378...) and golden-run.log (b2fb05f4...) re-verified; run_golden.sh line 20 runs the frozen golden as uid 65534 with env -i NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules in image cw-editor-agent-r3, whose docker history shows the same apt/npm -g layers as this Dockerfile, so the preinstalled-dependency premise held in practice. Internal sheet text 'no-network' is superseded by the project override (SKILL.md line 26; Quality Checks D10 'network_mode = "public" is correct - do not flag it'), so public posture is not flagged. Counterexample search: (a) conforming alternative that fails - an agent that runs `npm install` locally (including better-sqlite3 prebuild download) still works because network is public and 4 GB suffices; an app run from a different cwd is covered publicly by integration.md. (b) weak app that passes - not applicable to this structural row. Minor evidence note (not a defect for this row): the golden image was built from the identical template Dockerfile under a different environment context (colderwater assets/instructions), not a build of this exact environment folder; only the COPY payload differs and the golden mounts Kittle's assets explicitly.
